cards.title: Document / Style
cards.body:
Pixel-art style concept/model sheet · not a sprite sheet
#03 · Late-SNK-Realism · Garou: Mark of the Wolves
Neo Geo (MVS) / 1999
Artist ref: Eisuke Ogura · SNK illustration reference
Signature: Bold gesture, graphic facial planes, hard contrast

cards.title: Lineart
cards.body:
Ultra-precise fine 1 px-like contours
Hard square clusters · crisp silhouette edges
Deep navy outline #000055

cards.title: Morphology
cards.body:
Realistic athletic construction · low center in action
Adapted to tall, slim ectomorph
Long limbs; no bulky or chibi redesign

cards.title: Shading
cards.body:
Technical 3–4 tone material ramps
Muted values · controlled highlights
Clean clusters; no dithering or smoothing

cards.title: Biotype
cards.body:
Selected: tall, slim ectomorph
Options: ectomorph · mesomorph · endomorph
muscular · petite · slim · athletic · curvy
heavy muscular · short

cards.title: Relative Scale
cards.body:
H = crown-to-chin head height · target ~7.5H
Orthographic views share scale and baseline
Visual guide, not canonical absolute height

cards.title: Palette / Effects
cards.body:
Fixed game palette: blue/cyan, teal, white, gray, burgundy, brown
Red/brass accents; violet only on occult steel boomerang
Concept illustration; colors not quantized

cards.title: Background / Alignment
cards.body:
Clean neutral cream · no scenery or texture
Horizontal lineup · common scale and baseline

cards.title: Fixed Character Details
cards.body:
Gray hair · round brass glasses · cane · rapier
Steel boomerang · fully human; no monster traits

artistic_style_reference.reference_role_and_scope: SNK illustrator/character designer; official SNK profile documents his Garou-team connection and broader Fatal Fury work. Reference for a forceful SNK illustration direction, not a claim of sole authorship of Garou: Mark of the Wolves pixels.
style_signature: graphic facial planes and strong gesture
broad shape contrast with direct action staging
artistic_style_reference.basis_and_limits: The phrasing of visual traits is an editorial reading of representative artwork; keep distinct from Shinkiro’s more realistic promotional rendering.

annotation_revision.preserved_artwork_note: Artwork is preserved from the versioned source. For card-only revisions, all pixels outside the document/style card are unchanged.
